intervals.EOC: Student-t two-sided 95%; ddof=1 SD and MCSE
intervals.synthetic_false_elimination: Clopper-Pearson two-sided 95% plus one-sided 95% upper bound
intervals.independent_proportion_difference: Newcombe hybrid-score interval from independent Wilson limits
intervals.independent_mean_difference: Welch-Satterthwaite two-sided 95%; degenerate SE=0 gives point interval
intervals.reference_sensitivity: Path-level percentile bootstrap 2.5/97.5%, distinct from selection MC uncertainty
intervals.VRR: Resample rows jointly within each ON/OFF matrix independently; percentile 95%

bootstrap_best_ties: lowest policy ID, rank by mean descending then ID
reference_uncertain_rule: top1/top3/epsilon-set changes 10000->20000 OR any nonbest policy within 3 paired-gap MCSE of epsilon boundary
